verdict.rationale: Framer is a design and website builder, so a developer inspect/handoff mode is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack never mentions an inspect panel, layer measurements, style or asset export, CSS/iOS/Android code snippets, or viewer-only (non-editor) access. Plugins, code components and external-agent access are adjacent developer building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect any layer and get measurements, styles, assets, and code snippets (CSS/iOS/Android) without an editor seat
